title: 14 CFR § 89.125 Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) Out prohibition. (2025 edition)

heading_path: 14 CFR § 89.125 Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) Out prohibition. (2025 edition)
sections.text: Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) Out equipment cannot be used to comply with the remote identification requirements of this part.
